verdict.rationale: Users can drive Brave Search with natural language through the official MCP server in Claude Desktop and other MCP clients, through Skills for coding agents like Claude Code and Cursor, and through the Answers endpoint, which takes natural-language questions and returns grounded AI answers. However, this works only through third-party agent clients, and the evidence never shows natural-language operation of the product itself, such as configuring parameters, Goggles, plans or keys. Missing for 10: native natural-language control of product configuration and account management, and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language-driven operation.
